name: Andrzej Halicki, Matjaž Nemec - Après le § 68 - Am 146
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2026
part_text: 68 a. Underlines that Union funds must under no circumstances be used to compensate for or cover the suspension or reorientation of United States aid, including that provided by USAID and by the Bureau of Democracy, Human Rights and Labor of the State Department;
